description: Action ids carry a per-plan stamp and depends_on is remapped in the same pass, so a re-plan can never reuse an id or resolve a dependency into an earlier plan.
why_it_exists: Validate Plan JSON minted ids purely positionally (ACT-<matter>-003), so a re-plan reused the same id for a different action, making ids non-unique. The first fix - upsert on position - was worse: it silently OVERWROTE the old row, changing what ACT-...-003 meant while Drafts and Approvals rows still referenced it.

input.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

items.facts_json: {"incident_description": "Rear quarter panel struck while the vehicle was parked and unattended.", "incident_datetime": "UNVERIFIED: unknown; discovered 2026-08-14 about 18:00 AWST; occurred while parked", "incident_location": "Level 2, Hay Street car park, Perth WA", "owner_present": "no", "driver_identity": "vehicle was unattended", "own_vehicle_registration": "9XYZ876", "damage_description": "Dent and paint transfer to the rear quarter panel."}

expect.depends_on_remapped_to: the stamped id of action 1 from THIS plan

assertions: The plan stamp is 'P' plus base36 epoch seconds upper-cased, which sorts correctly when parsed back with parseInt(s, 36) - that is how readers rank plans.
Every action id in a plan shares one stamp, and no two plans on the same matter can share a stamp.
depends_on_json entries are rewritten through the same id map in the same pass, so a dependency can never resolve against an action belonging to a different plan.
idempotency_key is matter_id | plan_stamp | positional sequence, so an append is idempotent within a plan but never collides across plans.
Nothing is overwritten or deleted - readers pick the newest stamp per matter and history stays intact.
